dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| extend CefMessageCount = countof(RawData, base64_decodestring("KD9tKV4oPzo8WzAtOV17MSwzfT4xIFteXHJcbl0qPyApP0NFRjo="), "regex")
| extend CefMessage = extract(base64_decodestring("KD9zKV4oPzo8WzAtOV17MSwzfT4xIFteXHJcbl0qPyApPyhDRUY6LiopJA=="), 1, RawData)
| extend CanParse = CefMessageCount == 1 and
    CefMessage matches regex base64_decodestring("XkNFRjpbXnxcXFxyXG5dK1x8KD86KD86W158XFxcclxuXXxcXFteXHJcbl0pKlx8KXs2fVteXHJcbl0qW1xyXG5dKiQ=")
| extend CefMessage = replace(";", " ", CefMessage)
| extend ParsedCef = parse_cef_dictionary(iff(CanParse,
    CefMessage, "CEF:0|Unknown|Unknown|0|Unknown|Unknown|0|placeholder=1"))
| extend ParseStatus = case(CefMessageCount > 1, "Batched",
    CefMessageCount == 0, "NonCef",
    CanParse == false or isnull(ParsedCef["Extension"]), "MalformedCef", "Parsed")
| extend CefExtensions = iff(ParseStatus == "Parsed", ParsedCef["Extension"], parse_json("{}"))
| extend EventTime = iff(isnotnull(todatetime(CefExtensions["createdAt"])),
    todatetime(CefExtensions["createdAt"]), todatetime(CefExtensions["time"]))
| project TimeGenerated = iff(isnotnull(EventTime), EventTime, TimeGenerated),
    RawData, ParseStatus,
    EventId = tostring(CefExtensions["id"]),
    EventTime,
    EventName = iff(isnotempty(tostring(CefExtensions["event"])),
        tostring(CefExtensions["event"]), tostring(CefExtensions["product"])),
    EventCategory = iff(isnotempty(tostring(CefExtensions["category"])),
        tostring(CefExtensions["category"]), tostring(CefExtensions["product_family"])),
    Severity = tostring(CefExtensions["severity"]),
    ActorEmail = tostring(CefExtensions["createdBy"]),
    Module = tostring(CefExtensions["module"]),
    Message = iff(isnotempty(tostring(CefExtensions["eventData"])),
        tostring(CefExtensions["eventData"]),
        tostring(parse_json(tostring(CefExtensions["data"]))["message"])),
    CefExtensions
